reviews.title: Decent - good idea but not there yet
reviews.text:
Ultimately, this is a good idea, but a huge letdown in terms of the actual user experience and functionality. The conversational AI that I expected is not so conversational after all. The app does a good job of setting up scenarios and having you walk-through and build upon very basic sentences as you go. 

However, there’s a major breakdown and miss when it comes to creating conversational AI where you can go back-and-forth or debate points. For example, I was going through a lesson that included a mock scenario where I am a Chef and I needed to propose a new menu idea to my boss. Despite Pingo giving me the topic, it suggested that I needed to ask for more “engineers“. It was then difficult to reason with Pingo about how a real conversation like this would go so that in the theory, I’d be ready for a conversation like this in real life. Instead, I had a conversation that was half baked and a little nonsensical, and all Pingo did was provide me with basic grammar rules that I should adhere to when proposing an argument.

It would be helpful in this scenario if you could go back-and-forth with the AI chat bot in the same way that you could with a ChatGPT or Copilot. If I role-play with the spoken, ChatGPT feature, it will often suggest things or push back on things if instructed. I would think for a dedicated voice chat bot feature in a language learning app, it would be able to take on different example personas in order to simulate real conversation, which is what most people are looking for when they’re learning languages rather than the traditional “flashcards” type app.

reviews.text:
I really like this app. This is my 3rd year of learning español. 

First year was Duolingo. Then 2nd year Pimsler. 

I really like this because unlike the other 2 apps if I don’t understand something fully. I can stop it mid sentence and question it.

I can ask it any question and I can role play any situation I like. It’s brilliant. 

Sometimes the audio goes a bit robotic at times but I just tell it to repeat or I can follow the transcript. 

Definitely the best thing I’ve used. It’s like having your own personal tutor that you can use whenever and wherever!

I can tell it to speak to me only in English for this part but I have picked up on so many useful phrases just by it talking to me in Español.

reviews.text:
App fails at the chat portion. You can have a long conversation but it’ll loop back to the original topic and try to correct you.

Example: you ask Pingo to tslk about weather in another language. Pingo tries to teach you “it’s thunderstorming” response. 

You respond. Pingo approves. Then if you try to extend the conversation. Pingo instead of replying says “you’re incorrect.” It doesn’t matter if you complete the request or try to continue the conversation…Pingo just loops back to trying to teach you “it’s thunderstorming” after youve already successfully answered and want to move on. 

The app needs work and I’m unsatisfied with it as it also adds extra words sometimes to your response.
